runs.text: The proof that it is unobservable is strong: running a program collecting on

blocks.title: Objects created and forgotten

runs.text: Every round creates a box that stops being reachable when the round ends. Suspended tasks are roots too: what their frames hold, their pending results and the channels' messages stay alive as long as needed.
